g.title: appendix
g.text: Logic of appendix_advanced_ml.R (run once per seed: 2026 = main results, 2028 = sensitivity check)

g.title: cluster_train
g.text: TRAINING SET ONLY (38 patients). The test set is never seen here.

g.title: cluster_outer
g.text: nested_cv(): for each repeat r and outer fold f (4 procedures, same folds)

g.title: cluster_fit
g.text: Inside fit_model(fitting rows only)

g.title: data
g.text: golubEsets
Golub_Train: 38 patients (27 ALL, 11 AML), all bone marrow
Golub_Test: 34 patients (20 ALL, 14 AML), 24 BM + 10 PB

g.title: prep
g.text: Fixed preprocessing, applied to both sets
floor 100, ceiling 16000, log10
(fixed numbers: nothing learned from the data)

g.title: repro
g.text: Reproduce the original (leaky) estimate
rank genes on all 38, caret 5-fold CV
check: same top-10 genes, AUC = 1 for every k, k = 15

g.title: plan
g.text: make_plan(): draw all folds up front
20 repeats x stratified 5 outer folds
+ stratified 5 inner folds inside each outer training part
(assert: every fold has both ALL and AML)

g.title: split
g.text: Outer split
outer training part (~30) | outer validation fold (~8, held out)

g.title: perm
g.text: Permutation test (elastic net only)
shuffle training labels x 200
rerun the FULL nested CV each time
-> null AUC distribution, empirical p (E2)

g.title: plan->perm
g.text: new folds for
each permutation

g.title: stab
g.text: Gene stability (elastic net, shrunken centroids)
100 stratified 80% subsamples, fit_model on each
count how often each probe is selected
add symbols (GEO GPL80), direction, top-10 overlap (F)

g.title: fit
g.text: fit_model(outer training rows ONLY)
details: yellow box, Inside fit_model

g.title: pred
g.text: Predict the held-out fold
-> P(AML) for each patient
call AML if P >= 0.5 and if P >= Youden cut

g.title: f1
g.text: Variation filter on the fitting rows
max/min > 5 and max - min > 500

g.title: final
g.text: Final model per procedure
fit_model on all 38 training patients
(one stratified 5-fold inner split)

g.title: fit->final
g.text: same procedure,
all 38 rows

g.title: pool
g.text: Pool out-of-fold predictions per repeat (every patient once)
AUC, sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, balanced accuracy
summarise over 20 repeats -> A2, A3 (tuning), A4 (pooled vs fold-averaged)

g.title: canary
g.text: Leakage canary checks (I)
replace outer-validation rows with noise + flipped labels, refit:
identical fit? replace test set with noise: identical fit?
script stops if any check fails

g.title: f2
g.text: Inner CV (stratified 5-fold) to tune ONE setting
KNN: odd k <= 15 and k < 2 x AML in smallest inner fit set
(genes re-ranked by |log2 FC| inside every inner fold;
leaky KNN: 50 genes fixed from all 38)
Elastic net: lambda (alpha 0.5, class weights, deviance)
Shrunken centroids: shrinkage threshold (equal priors)

g.title: f3
g.text: Inner out-of-fold probabilities at the chosen setting
-> Youden cut-off (ties: closest to 0.5)

g.title: f4
g.text: Refit on ALL fitting rows with the chosen setting
KNN: top-50 |log2 FC| genes, z-score with fitting-row mean/SD
Elastic net / pamr: package standardisation on fitting rows

g.title: f5
g.text: Return: genes, k / lambda / shrinkage, cut-off,
selected probes

g.title: test
g.text: INDEPENDENT TEST SET (34): predict ONCE per model
no model, gene number, setting or cut-off chosen here

g.title: out1
g.text: Stratified bootstrap 95% CI (2000)
AUC, AML recall, specificity, accuracy
at 0.5 and at the training Youden cut (D2)
confusion matrices (D3), probabilities (D4)

g.title: out2
g.text: Misclassified patients
with sample source and hospital (D5)

g.title: out3
g.text: Bone marrow vs peripheral blood
per model, bootstrap CI (G)

g.title: figs
g.text: Figures 1-5, CSV tables, all_results.rds
RESULTS.md written from these tables
